board_key.note: epoch_known=false means this site cannot confirm which board is current. It is NOT a mismatch finding. epochs_agree=false means the published board is from a superseded epoch: the fix is to run scripts/publish-live-board.py, not to re-stamp anything. epoch_composed=true means ladder_epoch is a fallback to the current epoch because published-board.json predates the field -- the pair is composed, not observed.
